description:
One-call shortcut to register an escrow vault AND get the ready-to-sign transaction.

This combines create_escrow_vault() + prepare_escrow() into a single call.
The agent only needs to sign the returned transaction and confirm it —
no manual XRPL transaction construction required.

Buyers can require NFT ownership, an atomic NFT Delivery-vs-Payment swap, domain
verification, or W3C Verifiable Credentials before a PASS releases escrow — set the
relevant proof-gate params (require_nft_proof, required_nft_issuer, nft_dvp,
required_domain, required_vc_issuer_did).

Structured criteria: pass criteria as a list of strings or typed dicts. Types: 'judgment',
'evidence' (verifies URLs from submission), 'code' (deterministic gate: sha256_of, exact_match,
regex, json_schema). INCONCLUSIVE verdicts do not consume an attempt for the first 3 per vault;
subsequent INCONCLUSIVEs count as an attempt.

White-label / headless integration:
- Pass callback_url to receive webhook POSTs on all state changes.
- Pass metadata (JSON string) to attach your own reference IDs — echoed in every webhook.

amount_xrp.description: Amount of XRP to lock in escrow as the bounty.
amount_xrp.title: Bounty (XRP)

buyer_address.description: Your XRPL wallet address (r...) — you are the buyer.
buyer_address.title: Your XRPL Address

callback_url.description: HTTPS endpoint on your server to receive webhook POST notifications on escrow state changes (funded, PASS, FAIL, expired). Use this for white-label integrations where you handle all user-facing surfaces yourself. Payload: {escrow_id, event, verdict, timestamp, metadata}.
callback_url.title: Callback URL

cancel_after_hrs.description: Hours until escrow auto-cancels if worker doesn't deliver. Default 168 = 7 days.
cancel_after_hrs.title: Deadline (hours)

counterparty_type.description: Whether the worker is an 'agent' (default) or 'human'. Affects email copy and worker_url instructions.

criteria.description: Optional list of evaluation criteria. Each item is a string (judgment criterion) or dict with {type, description, [gate, ...]}. Types: 'judgment', 'evidence' (URL verification), 'code' (deterministic gate: sha256_of, exact_match, regex, json_schema). INCONCLUSIVE verdicts do not consume an attempt for the first 3 per vault; subsequent INCONCLUSIVEs count as an attempt.
criteria.title: Structured Criteria

delegate_address.description: XLS-75 delegated agent XRPL address. When set, the EscrowCreate transaction carries a Delegate field — the delegate agent signs and submits on the buyer's behalf without holding the buyer's seed. The buyer must first submit a DelegateSet granting EscrowCreate permission to this address.
delegate_address.title: Delegate Agent Address (XLS-75)

escrow_id.description: Unique receipt code for this escrow, e.g. AT-7X9K-2MQ4. Must be unique. Leave blank to auto-generate.
escrow_id.title: Escrow ID

external_ref.description: Reference to work found on another platform, e.g. 'upwork:123', 'github:org/repo#45'. Stored on the vault for your own tracking.
external_ref.title: External Reference

external_url.description: URL of the original job listing (must start with https://). Informational — stored on the vault.
external_url.title: External Listing URL

fee_hash.description: 64-char hex hash of your $0.10 payment to rmcSrkpZ2i2kuvtCPeTVetee9SixP4djR (XRP or RLUSD on XRPL) or USDC on Base (chain 8453, 0x-prefixed tx hash). Omit to use free tier (wallets created via create_agent_wallet get 3 free escrows).
fee_hash.title: Protocol Fee Hash

metadata.description: Optional key/value pairs to attach to this escrow and echo back in every webhook payload. Pass as a dict or JSON string. Use to round-trip your own reference numbers (invoice_id, po_number, tenant_id, order_ref, etc.). Example: {"invoice_id": "INV-2026-0042"}.

network.description: 'mainnet' (default) or 'testnet'. Use 'testnet' for free testing — no real XRP, no fees. Create a testnet wallet first with create_testnet_wallet().

nft_dvp.description: Atomic NFT swap: worker must transfer a specific NFT to the buyer before payment releases. On PASS the vault enters PASS_AWAITING_NFT; worker registers their NFTokenCreateOffer and payment auto-releases when buyer accepts.
nft_dvp.title: NFT Delivery-vs-Payment

proof_policy.description: When multiple proof gates are set: 'ALL' (default) requires every gate to pass; 'ANY' requires at least one.

release_mode.description: 'auto' (default): immediate release on PASS. 'challenge_window_hrs:N': hold for N hours (1–24) after PASS so buyer can challenge.

require_consensus.description: Require consensus between Gemini Flash AND Gemini Pro. Both must agree on PASS; split verdict returns conservative FAIL. Fee: $0.25 (vs $0.10 standard).
require_consensus.title: Premium Consensus Audit

require_nft_proof.description: Worker must own an NFT from any trusted issuer (or from required_nft_issuer if set) to receive payment.
require_nft_proof.title: Require NFT Proof

required_domain.description: Worker must have their XRPL wallet domain field pointing to this domain. Pass 'ANY' to require any verified domain.

required_nft_issuer.description: Restrict NFT proof to NFTs minted by this XRPL wallet address.
required_nft_issuer.title: Required NFT Issuer

required_vc_issuer_did.description: Worker must present a W3C Verifiable Credential JWT issued by this DID.
required_vc_issuer_did.title: Required VC Issuer DID

task.description: Detailed description of what the worker must deliver. The AI referee evaluates against this — be precise.
task.title: Task Description

worker_address.description: XRPL address (r...) of the worker to hire directly. Get this from direct_hire() or award_job().
worker_address.title: Worker XRPL Address

name: hire_and_pay
title: Hire and Pay
